description:
This release gathers everything since v0.10.0 and brings 88 patches for Facebook 582.0.0.50.54, up from 87. The new one is `Frame step`, which moves a paused reel or video one frame at a time. New switches hide comments with shop links or with words from your News feed list, let Home show just Friends, Favorites, Groups or Pages, and save crashes to Downloads so they can go with a bug report. The kept reel progress bar no longer jumps back on the first reel or sits under the caption, Material You reaches the Menu's top card and Log out strip, and the Reported issues list below maps each report this release touches.

New in this release

- New patch, `Frame step`, under Playback (issue #95). With it on, pause a reel or a video and tap the right third of the picture to move one frame forward, or the left third to move one frame back. The middle third plays it again, and taps on a playing video work as before. It starts off, and the report counts the steps each way.

- Two new switches under Comments in `Comment sheet options`, `Hide comments with shop links` and `Hide comments with your words` (issue #118). The first leaves out comments that link to Shopee, Lazada, Tokopedia, AliExpress, Temu, Shein, TikTok Shop or Amazon's short links, replies and all. The second leaves out comments holding something from your News feed `Words to hide` list, unless they also have something from `Words that keep a post`, so the one list now covers posts and comments. Both start off, and the report counts what each one hid.

- `Following feed on Home` has a new row under it, `Home shows`, for people who want Home to be just their friends. Pick Friends, Favorites, Groups or Pages and Home asks Facebook for that filter's newest posts, the same ones the Feeds tab shows under it. All, the default, keeps Home as it was. If your Facebook doesn't have the filter you picked, Home shows All, and the diagnostic report counts which feed Home asked for. The choice travels in an exported settings file.

- New switch under Privacy, `Save crashes to Downloads`, in every build and on from the start. When Facebook crashes, the error goes in a text file in Download/Hushfacebook, so it can go with a bug report even when Facebook won't open far enough to reach the settings. It holds the diagnostic report's crash section, with links and IDs left out, and the newest five are kept. Nothing is written while Hushfacebook is paused. The bug form now says where to find it.

Fixes

- A link to a site that isn't Meta's shows up in the diagnostic report's list of screens opened as "(outside link)" and nothing more. The list used to keep the site and the page's path, so a report could name a page you read in Facebook's browser or a file you opened from it.

- Finished-save cards don't pile up any more. The shade keeps the newest twenty "Video saved" and "Photo saved" cards and lets the oldest go. Android stops an app at about fifty notifications and drops the next without a word, which could leave the next save's progress card, Cancel button and all, with no room to show.

- When the phone's decoder gives no sample rate for a reel's xHE-AAC sound, or changes its format part way through, the save falls back to Facebook's single file where there is one and the log says why. The first case used to end in a division by zero. The second would have gone on into sound that comes out wrong.

- Cancel, Pause, Resume, Undo, Add a topic pack, Back and Clear search in the settings show a ripple when tapped. They showed nothing before.

- `Turn off HDR brightness` also asks the phone's video decoder to bring an HDR video down to the usual range on Android 12 and newer (issue #93). Until now only the window was told to stay in the usual range, and a video the phone's own decoder plays, like a VP9 HLG reel, could still light the screen up. A decoder that turns the request down is set up again without it, so the video still plays, and the diagnostic report counts which way each decoder answered.

- With `Tap to play` on, a reel that's waiting for your tap no longer goes into picture-in-picture when you leave Facebook (issue #90). The window used to stay armed from the reel before, so going home opened a floating player for a reel you hadn't started. Once you tap play, leaving works as it did. A reel you were watching in the floating player also keeps playing when you open it back up into Facebook. Facebook pauses it on the way back and starts it again, and Tap to play used to hold that start, so the reel sat with its play button over the time you'd already watched.

- Facebook's push service no longer turns down a patched Facebook (issue #112). On a re-signed build it checked Facebook's certificate, didn't recognize it, stopped and got started again, over and over, and each round could leave threads running, which can drain the battery. It now gets Facebook's original certificate for that check, the same fix HushThreads got for Threads. It's part of every build, whichever patches you pick.

- A save WhatsApp may refuse shows one card in the shade. It has Open and Share like any finished save, says why the video may be refused and adds an `Open the setting` button. It used to post a second card next to the finished-save one.

- Two saves finishing in the same moment keep twenty finished-save cards. Each one trimmed the shade on its own, so they could both let a card go and leave nineteen.

- The Messenger link test under Links writes its result into its own row, where it stays readable. It used to show as a long toast that some phones cut short.

- With `Keep the progress bar` and `Show a reel's time` on, the first reel's bar no longer jumps back to the start while it plays (issue #120). The time above the bar was refreshed before Facebook had checked that the reel's player was ready, and the code that writes the time moves the bar too, so each refresh could put the bar back at 0:00 until the player caught up. The time is now refreshed only after Facebook has moved the bar itself.

- After you pick a different app icon, the `Hushfacebook settings` shortcut on a long press of the icon opens the settings again (issue #119). Picking an icon switches Facebook's usual launcher entry off and the icon's own entry on, and the shortcut still pointed at the one that was off, so tapping it did nothing. It now points at whichever entry is on, and so do the buttons on a notification that open a setting and the Open and Share buttons on a saved file's card. The shortcut catches up the next time Facebook starts.

- With `Default comment order` set to All comments, a friend's post no longer opens with no comments (issue #110). Asking for All comments up front got some posts an empty answer, while Newest and Most relevant got their comments. Comments now open in Facebook's order first, and when the post's sort menu offers All comments, it's picked there the same way a tap does. A post without that choice keeps Facebook's order.

- With `Keep the progress bar` on, a playing reel's caption no longer sits on top of the bar and its time (issue #73). Facebook moves the caption up only while a reel is paused, so it now keeps that paused layout while the reel plays too. Short reels whose bar showed for a moment and then faded out keep it as well. The diagnostic report counts any reel whose bar Facebook still hides.

- With `Material You theme` in dark mode, the card at the top of Menu with your name and picture takes your palette, and so does the strip behind Log out at the bottom (issue #37). Facebook's server sends the card's gray along with the Menu's layout, and the strip loads the gray Facebook keeps for cards as a picture, two paths the theme didn't reach.

- With `Material You theme` in dark mode, the Create story tile at the start of the stories tray takes your palette under your picture (issue #37). Facebook writes that gray straight into its code for dark mode.

- With `Material You theme` in dark mode, the box under a link post's picture takes your palette in the feed as well (issue #37). The 0.10.0 fix waited for Facebook to say dark mode was on, and Facebook lays out the first posts of a cold start before it says so, so those boxes could stay gray.

- In Indonesian and Turkish, the Following feed on Home summary and the Feeds header call the Feeds tab by the same name as the rest of those settings ("Feed" and "Akışlar"). They said "Feeds".

Other changes

- Summaries and toasts call the Marketplace switch's state Marketplace only, like the switch does. Some said "Marketplace mode", which isn't a name you'd find in the settings search.

- The seen posts row is called `Keep seen posts hidden for`, so it makes sense on its own in the settings search. While `Hide posts you've already seen` is off, its summary says to turn that on first.

- Ready for Android 17, which Samsung phones are getting with One UI 9. The reels filters that drop items from a section no longer treat a list the section's class keeps for itself as the section's items. Writing back into one of those is refused once Facebook targets Android 17, and could change every section at once before that. CONTRIBUTING.md lists what else Android 17 changes and why the rest doesn't touch Hushfacebook, and the settings and pause tests also run on Android 17 now.

- `Unlock app icons` says where to pick an icon (issue #122). The icons are on Facebook's own App icon page, at Menu > Settings and privacy > App icon, and the switch's summary used to say only "its App icon page". Patch descriptions in Morphe Manager say the same now.

Reported issues

- #120 Progress bar resetting with Keep the progress bar on: the first reel's bar moves on from where the reel is and goes back to the start only when the reel does.

- #119 Hushfacebook settings not opening from a long press on the icon: after you pick a different app icon, the shortcut opens the settings again once Facebook has restarted.

- #110 Comment sorting: with `Default comment order` on All comments, a friend's post opens with its comments, and All comments is picked in the post's own sort menu where it has one.

- #73 Keep the reel progress bar visible: a playing reel's caption stays above the bar and its time, and short reels keep the bar.

- #37 Material You in dark mode: the card at the top of Menu, the strip behind Log out, the Create story tile and the link boxes Facebook lays out first on a cold start take your palette.

- #122 and #109 Unlocked icons: the `Unlock app icons` switch says where the icons are, Menu > Settings and privacy > App icon.

- #90 Elapsed time on a reel before tapping play: a reel waiting for your tap stays out of picture-in-picture, and a reel coming back from the floating player keeps playing.

- #93 HDR videos with Turn off HDR brightness on: the switch also asks the phone's video decoder to keep HDR video in the usual range.

- #95 Frame mode: the new `Frame step` patch moves a paused reel or video one frame at a time.

- #118 Hiding promotional link comments: `Hide comments with shop links` and `Hide comments with your words` under Comments.

- #112 Battery drain on a re-signed build: Facebook's push service accepts a patched Facebook instead of stopping and restarting over and over.

Behind the scenes

- When the release notes check turns down the phrase about which Facebook builds a release was tried on, its error says the word Facebook has to come right after "to". The 0.10.0 notes were refused once for "to both Facebook" with no hint why.

- The release receipt checks that every patched build keeps its native libraries 16 KB aligned, which Android 17 phones with 16 KB pages need, and records it. A build that isn't stops the release.

- CONTRIBUTING.md no longer names an old release and its patch counts, and the release facts check now holds its patcher version and Manager floor to the pins, the way it does the README's.

The [changelog](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/Hushfacebook/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) has every earlier release too.

How to update

1. Update Morphe Manager to 1.34.0 or newer, then refresh the Hushfacebook source.
2. Patch Facebook `582.0.0.50.54`. On most phones that's build `475417104`, the arm64-v8a one. Phones with a 32-bit processor take build `475417036`, the armeabi-v7a one.
3. Install over your current patched Facebook with the manager's existing signing key. Keep that key so updates keep working.

The `.mpp` download is a patch bundle, not a Facebook APK. [Installation instructions](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/Hushfacebook#install).

Look over a diagnostic report before you share it. The filter can still miss private text it doesn't recognize.

What was checked

Local checks passed: 2541 runtime tests and 886 patch tests with no failures, plus both Android lints and the release-script checks. All 88 patches applied without forcing to Facebook 582.0.0.50.54, both the arm64-v8a and the 32-bit build, and the only manifest changes are the four permission renames that let it install beside Meta's apps. I also patched 582 on an emulator, where Facebook opened signed in with no crash. There the first reel's kept progress bar ran on through two loops without jumping back and its caption stayed above it, a friend's post with All comments set opened with its comments, a Facebook Plus icon applied and the Hushfacebook settings shortcut opened from it after a restart, Frame step moved a paused reel one frame each way, and in dark mode Material You colored the Menu's top card, the strip behind Log out and the Create story tile while light mode stayed stock.
